result: PARTIAL — 15 operators + 4 Phase C workloads deleted through oc-deps, but 6 pre-configured explicit targets missed
root_cause: Individual teardown plan CLI (--delete-resource) was used for only the 4 Phase C targets. The 6 existing delete_resources entries in configs/full-teardown.json (2 for rhods-operator, 4 for rhcl-operator) were NOT passed as --delete-resource CLI flags. The config file is consumed by teardown apply --config batch flow, not individual plan+apply.

what_worked.4_phase_c_workloads: all deleted through oc-deps explicit_deletes (UID-bound, ref-guard, backup)

what_failed.manual_remediation: 6 targets deleted via direct oc delete (bypassed plan/UID/ref-guard/backup/journal)

audit_incomplete_issue.cause: CronJob/image-pruner in openshift-image-registry had missing TypeMeta from k8s LIST
audit_incomplete_issue.fix: TypeMeta normalization added to audit_list in post-attempt commit d4c63ea

lesson: Individual plan+apply must include ALL configured delete_resources for the operator, not just Phase C additions. Use --delete-resource for every entry.
